purpose: Bypass per-terminal 59D witness materialization for the genus-0 nonconic BTVA necessary condition by asking directly whether any integral Picard64 lift of one retained compressed fibration/Picard observable state has exceptional support spanning P6.

ownership.relation: MAIN consumes exact infrastructure from historical EX5 and the live 178 compressed-observable interface, but the new decision problem is existential support compatibility on the compressed key rather than terminal witness materialization.

stage34_arsenal.use_here: method pattern only; Stage34 receiver theorem and StageA2 family theorem are not transferred

exact_interface.lane178_fact: The 12 observables are exact integral linear forms on retained Picard64 and their image-lattice extendability is certified exactly by HNF congruences.
exact_interface.picard_variable: x in Z^64 retained Picard basis
exact_interface.exceptional_pairings: y_k = <E_k,x> for the 48 exceptional classes, k=0..47, using all140 slots 92..139 and BC2-01B node identity.
safe_relaxed_effective_curve_conditions: the twelve compressed observables equal the requested static/residual key
exact_interface.why_relaxed_is_safe: Dropping nonexceptional all140 positivity only enlarges the lift set. UNSAT after adding BTVA is therefore still a sound exclusion of an actual curve; SAT grants no curve/effectivity credit.

btva_genus0_nonconic.necessary_condition: support has at least seven singular nodes and those nodes span P6, excluding the separately handled 32 plane conics
btva_genus0_nonconic.integer_equivalence: because y_k are nonnegative integers, k is outside support iff y_k=0 and positive support outside a set is equivalent to the corresponding sum being at least one

algorithm: Solve the exact integral Picard64 lift system for the fixed compressed observable key.
If UNSAT, the compressed key is impossible even before BTVA.
If SAT, compute the exact Q(i)-linear rank of canonical coordinates of nodes with y_k>0.
If rank is 7, a BTVA-compatible support lift exists and this route does not reject the key.
If rank is <7, let F be all of the 48 canonical nodes lying in the exact projective linear span of that support.
Add the exact integer cut sum_{k notin F} y_k >= 1 and solve again.
Retain all prior flat cuts. Repeat until rank 7 is found or the system is UNSAT.
lazy_flat_separation.cut_soundness: Every support spanning P6 must contain a node outside every proper flat F. Thus each cut removes only lifts whose support is contained in a BTVA-forbidden proper flat.
lazy_flat_separation.finite_termination: Only finitely many closures F occur on a fixed 48-node configuration; each newly added cut permanently excludes one previously realized closure.

relation_to_old_blocker.old_blocker: current retained FULL178 census lacked a 59-entry witness or directly verified 48-support certificate per candidate
relation_to_old_blocker.bypass: The proposed consumer never asks for a retained support certificate per terminal. It existentially quantifies the full integral Picard64 lift inside each compressed observable fiber and asks only whether some BTVA-compatible support exists.
